plain: A formal written paper that is proof of a grant of rights or of an agreement

webster.text: A written instrument, executed with usual forms, given as evidence of a grant, contract, or whatever is done between man and man.

example.quote: This paper will be called the law of nations in America; it will be the Great Charter of America; it will be paramount to every thing.
example.cite: Jonathan Elliot, ed., The Debates in the Several State Conventions on the Adoption of the Federal Constitution, vol. 3, Virginia Convention, June 18, 1788 (2d ed. 1836)
